title: Dr. Chao-Min Liu 劉兆民博士
content_html:
CHAO-MIN LIU (born 1936, Min-Hsiung, Taiwan)

Education:
1. Art Studio of Mr. Shin-Ruh Liu, Taiwan, 1946-1962
2. Art Students League of New York, New York, 1982-1985 (Studio of H. Dinnerstein, H. Holms, D. Dickerson)
3. Art Studio of Curtis Hanson, Cornwell, Connecticut, 1985-1989
4. Ridgewood Art Institute, Ridgewood, NJ, 1989-1992 (Studio of Art Maynard)
Ph.D. & M.S. (Biochemistry), University of Wisconsin, Madison, WI, 1969, 1967
M.S. & B.S. (Plant Pathology), National Taiwan University, Taipei, Taiwan, 1960, 1958

Awards & Honors:
Anthony Bongiovani-Micro Strategies Award, Annual Juried Art Exhibition, West Essex Art Association (WEAA), 2014; Honorable Mentions, WEAA Annual Member Show, 2013; Libby Schmidt Memorial Merit Award, Annual Juried Art Exhibition, WEAA, 2010; Honorable Mentions, Annual Juried Art Exhibition, WEAA, 2009; Best Waterscape, Annual Juried Art Exhibition, WEAA, 2008; The Progress Award, Annual Juried Art Exhibition, WEAA, 2005; West Essex Lions Award, Annual Juried Art Exhibition, WEAA, 2001; Honorary Mention, Annual Juried Art Exhibition, WEAA, 1997; Caldwell Award, Annual Juried Art Exhibition, WEAA, 1996.

Group Exhibitions:
Second Annual Summer Exhibition, Manhattan Borough President’s Office, NY City, 2013; “Women in the Park” show, Licht Brick Art Gallery, Malvern, Long Island, NY, 2004; Audubon Society Annual Juried Show, NY, NY, 2004; Salmagundi Club, New York non-member juried show, 2004; Shin-Ruh Liu and his family member group Art Show, Min-Hsiung, Taiwan, 2004; Taiwanese American Association of Greater New York Art Exhibition, Flushing, NY, 2004; Annual Juried Art Exhibition, Ridgewood Art Institute, NJ, 1993, 1995, 1997; Annual Juried Art Exhibition, WEAA, 1995-2014 (multiple years); Essex County, NJ Juried Art Show, 1989; Connecticut Landscape Painters Group Show, 1988.

Solo Exhibitions:
Culture Center, City of Kaohsiung, Taiwan, 1998; Culture Center, City of Taichung, Taiwan, 2000; Amerasia Bank Art Gallery, Flushing, New York, 2010; Min-Shiong Culture & Education Foundation, Taiwan, 2014; Culture Center, City of Chiayi, Taiwan, 2015.

Publications:
1. Picture illustrations in “Break the Shell” published by Dharma Realm Buddhist Association & The City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, Ukiah, CA, 2007.
2. “Farm Market” and “Daisy Flowers” respectively, in Always Bright, Vol. 1, 1999 and Vol. 2, 2001.
3. “Oil Paintings by Chao-Min Liu,” Taipei, Taiwan, 1998.
4. Chao-Min Liu Oil Paintings – 劉兆民八十回顧展油畫集, published by 台灣嘉義市政府文化局, 2015.

Membership:
Life member, Art Students League of New York; Member, West Essex Art Association, NJ.

Selected works include: Still life, 20×24″, oil on canvas; Summer stream in NJ, 24×20″, oil on canvas; Raven, 20×16″, oil on canvas; Girl with white headband, 18×14″, oil on board; Delaware Gap from distance, 20×24″, oil on canvas; Rocky Monhegan Island shore, 16×20″, oil on canvas; Woman in Central Park, NY, 28×22″, oil on canvas, 2005.
